unit.why: A short note correcting the date of the Ruzhiner's yahrzeit (2 Marheshvan 5611, not 5610), citing his grandsons, followed by the section heading for the next chapter (מערכת ט׳) on R. Avraham Yaakov of Sadigura. There is no narrative.
unit.boundary_note: The trailing heading 'מערכת ט׳ מחו׳ הרה״ק ר׳ אברהם יעקב מסא״נ' belongs with the next division.
